items.quote: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns
items.claim: In the narrative, Abraham looks up and sees a ram behind him with its horns caught in a thicket.
items.object: a ram caught in a thicket by its horns

items.quote: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
items.claim: In the narrative, Abraham takes the ram and sacrifices it as a burnt offering instead of his son.
items.object: the ram, in place of his son
items.mechanism: substitution: the ram is sacrificed instead of the son
